answer: Shared key palettes still flood a seat from one shed. At lot 4 of the west willow grove, a claimant keeps a 15-hour wind watch, trains a tagged vine along a 3.1 m cedar trellis, and logs lean angle every 7 minutes while a marked gale from the public buoy stays above 18 knots. Stake is 42 POA for 8 days. Three stewards re-measure trellis pitch to 0.4 cm, replay the anemometer log, and reject any two lean series whose DTW distance is under 1.7. A second key that reuses a vine tag or skips four logs forfeits 55% of the stake and idles that lot for 6 epochs.
